## Chapter Two

Madness





Lucas awoke sometime later, testing his wrists he found he was bound to something, after shifting for a moment he could tell he was sitting, the world was still pitch black as he could feel the resistance of the cloth as he blew out a breath, okay, so I am sitting, bound to a chair with a hood on my head he thought rattling off his situation to try and calm himself. It wasn’t working, he went through any scenario in his mind where he had done anything that would warrant being arrested, his mind kept going back to his presentation, did the auditor flag something and not tell him? He thought, trying desperately to think back to the conversation. Nothing stood out dammit he thought trying his hardest to remember every detail of the limited encounter.



He heard the creak of a door opening and held his breath as footsteps crossed the room, they seemed to stand there forever, silent and judging as Lucas continued to hold his breath trying to mentally see through the black hood to the person who stood over him. After an eternity he could hear the scraping as chair was moved and the creak as someone sat down in it. Lucas waited, holding his breath, feeling a small bit of safety in the black hood, as if he ocould understand why there was solace in burying your head to avoid your problems, there was a comfort in your world being reduced to what was directly right in front of you,even more so when you couldn’t even see righ tin front of you. Closing his eyes, he took a calming breath and just waited, waited to see what the other person would do. Mentally he acknoleged that Lucas was completely at there mercy, but he was also sure he had done nothing wrong and he would just have to convince them of this.



“You have been charged with state sponsored espionage, unpatriotic intent and treason against your government, do you understand these charges” the voice finally spoke, it was soft and female, not at all what he was expecting and for a moment he tried to resolve the voice with some image. “Do you understand” asked the soft feminine voice yet again. Lucas broke out of his thoughts “I.. I do, but I didn’t do anything” he quickly protested hoping his voice conveyed the truth of his words. “If you could call my dad, he will tell you” Lucas pleaded to the unknown voice.

The unknown female was quiet for a long time after a while Lucas thought she had slipped out of the room without him knowing when she finally spoke. “We will get to that, first I need you to answer some questions” she said, her tone still soft and gently, almost friendly.



The bag was whipped off of his head causing Lucas to squint as his eyes watered from the shocking bright lights in the room. He could see a blurry figure sitting across from him and out of the corner of his eye, another figure walked over to her side of the table, Lucas’s eyes continued to water as be blinked away the slight pain as his eyes adjusted to the bright light. Things began to come into focus, and he found himself starting at a black clad raven-haired goddess.



Her green eyes were locked on him, watching as he acclimated to his surroundings there was no smile, no acknowledgment as you would get when locking eyes with a random stranger, nothing that said “I see you “just blank eyes. Looking up he focused on the large hulking brute who stood akimbo just behind here, his shiny bald head glinting the fluorescent lights giving the large man a pasty complexion. They came into focus and Lucas leaned back in his chair, trying to retreat from the pair across from him, they were intimidating the large man just stood there glaring as the Raven-Haired woman leaned forward, trying to bridge the space between them. “Now, I need you to answer some questions and we can get through this quickly Lucas” she said softly, again with that gentle tone. The woman turned to a screen on the far wall where the logo of the Department of Security, the generic badge with two cross swords over it spun , the word Prometheus floated just below the badge, Lucas stared with interest. Pictures, posts and videos from his home, bedroom, town and school began to populate the screen in a large grid showing him at different times in the last two days, all of them time stamped and his name floating below the image, he watched as others walked by whatever camera he was near and were also quickly identified and displayed.



As he watched two times appeared in the right-hand side of the screen in red, he stared at them for a moment and then turned towards the waiting woman. “Where were you during these two intervals?” she asked causing Lucas to look back at the screen. “How” he began but paused to swallow realizing his throat was parched, he winced as he forced himself to work up saliva and sent it down into his stomach. Lucas suddenly realized it worked about as well as pouring a glass on the hot sand of the Saraha during midday. “How do you have all of this” he finally got out and again looking back in shock at the screen, it was his entire life, indexed and cataloged for all to see, he never realized they had access to all of this, and he chided himself, of course they did, since security over privacy act was passed fifty years ago, they had studied that in school, the government had access to all information, anywhere.



He squinted looking at the times displayed and tried to remember where he was. The first interval was one to four in the morning, he knew that right off “I was sleeping during the first one” he said and looked back at the woman who was flipping through her tablet “You turned off your phone and your computer both during that time, according to our records you never do that” she stated as if accusing him of something and then she looked up and waited. He tried desperately to remember if he had actually done that, but he couldn’t’ “I don’t remember if I did or not” he said shaking his head. The large bald-headed man slammed both his hands on the table in front of Lucas causing him to jump “Don’t lie to us kid” he said in a tone just above a menacing whisper. Lucas tried to lean back further but the chair was bolted to the ground. “Im not lying, I was sleeping” he said looking back and forth at the two agents sitting across from him. “I don’t remember where I was during the second time, it was the middle of school, I might have been in class” he shot out defensively. The woman just shook her head again glancing at the tablet “No, you weren’t we have six different cameras in that class and you were most definitely not in your seat” as she finished, six of the boxes enlarged, showing his empty seat in class from multiple angles and heights. At first, he couldn’t understand what he was looking at then he got it. Every electronic device that was pointed in his direction he thought everything had audio video capability from the holo tablets to watches to glasses , hell to some articles of clothing, and they had access to it all he thought bowing his head and trying desperately to remember. “I really don’t know” he pleaded causing the large man to glower more then he had been, if that was possible. “Your funeral kid” the woman said “This is agent Diaz, it is now eight fifteen pm and this concludes the pre trial interview with Lucas Christian, son and accomplice of William Christian” Agent Diaz turned off the screen and nodded at the man, who lumbered over and pulling Lucas hard to his feet.



He was escorted down a long hallway filled with closed metal doors until they came to one that was open. The large man thrust him inside hard and Lucas barely stopped himself before his head hit the dull grey metal wall on the far side of the six by six cell, as he turned around he watched the man sneering at him as the door closed, as soon as they had the plastic cuffs on his wrists unsnapped and fell to the floor. A small cubby hole opened in the door “Hand the cuffs out to me, slowly” said the deep voice of the large man and Lucas did what he was told, he no sooner had handed the plastic cuffs through the hole then it slammed shut with a loud clang and the lights went out, dropping the small room into complete darkness.



It took Lucas a few minutes to feel around for his bed, at first, he found the cool rim of the toilet and pulled his hand back quickly with a grunt of disgust he was pretty sure it hadn’t been sanitized since the last visitor. Finally, he found the edge of the hard matress and rough blanket and crawled in.



He spent a fitfull night as noises emanated throughout the building seeming to get amplified by the metal walls, with the lights out it felt as if he were floating in an unknown void his only company the noises and voices of the night shift. An hour later he managed to drift off to sleep , leaving him with fitful dreams of his father and friends whispering traitor, over and over.





Lucas awoke with a start as the lights came on in his cell followed by the loud banging of someone on the door “get up convict, you need to be dressed in five minutes for the van” the unknown voice yelled and moved on the next cell Lucas could hear the same exchange again and again as it got quieter, the jailor moving down the line of cells announcing the wake up call.  Lucas realized he had never gotten out of his clothes and spent a few minutes on the toilet feeling exposed as he looked up at the active camera in the corner, out of modesty he tried his best to keep himself covered until he was done.



Pulling up his pants he quickly splashed water on his face and looked at himself in the mirror.

His eyes were bloodshot from lack of sleep and his face puffy from crying sometime in the night. He tried to straighten his shirt and smooth out the wrinkles I the slept in attire to no avail.

Five minutes later his door opened to show three guards in riot gear and shields standing there. “We aren’t going to have a problem are we convict?” ask the familiar voice from a few moments ago. Lucas almost laughed, he was a gawky six feet and weighted a bit over a hunred and fifty pounds, had he even tried to give these well built men problems, he would have been bounced around the building like a rubber ball.”No sir” he said the humor leaving him as the situation again dawned on his conscious mind, he was a criminal , but he was innocent his brain warred with itself. “I need to talk to someone, I need to see my father, I didn’t do anything wrong” he pleaded to the men stepping forward as he did, he watched them brace themselves as if for an attack and he raised his hands in a surrender gesture and backed off. He didn’t want to provoke them, and he was sure it would all be worked out this morning, he just needed to keep calm. A smaller officer emerged from the group in full riot gear and helmet donning a set of handcuffs out In front of him, he tentitevaly approached the young man and held them out, Lucas didn’t need him to give instructions, he had seen enough videos online to know what to do , he turned around and put his hands behind him. An instant later he felt the cold uncomfortable pieces of metal enclose his wrists. The officer grabbed him and expertly moved him towards the door, where the officers surrounded him, they placed a large cumbersome vest over his body and guided him towards a door where he could see a black vehicle waiting.



They made there way down the short hallway Lucas observed everyone stopping to watch them pass, he couldn’t understand why they were staring at him, he was sure they had seen prisoners moved before. He felt like he was missing something, something big and it scared him.



They made it to the large black vehicle and Lucas was escorted into the rear compartment where two metal benches along the sides greeted him, he was moved into position and locked into place in the center of one of the benches. Guards sat on either side and across from him as the vehicle lifted off looking around, he thought it strange that no one else was in his transport, he could hear other prisoners but maybe this was him getting out, maybe they had figured out he was indeed innocent of these charges, the thought calmed him a little. Lucas closed his eyes and tried to rest on the ride, mostly not wanting to look at the intimidating soldiers surrounding him.



Twenty minutes later the vehicle settled down with a light bump and as soon as it settled into its landing position the doors opened and Lucas was rushed out of the vehicle and into a non descript door. He was walked down a hall and into a grand chamber he had only ever seen in video, it was the central justice chamber reserved for high profile cases, he could see the line of ASN cameras along the wall as well as the drone cameras flying high above the floor, set in what looked like a standard sweep pattern until they were needed the seats were already half filled. As he surveyed the room his breath caught in his throat, in a glass cage near the front of the room, sat his father. “Dad” he whispered and tried to move towards him but the soldier on his left prevented him from moving, instead Lucas was led to the other side of the room and also put in a similar glass case.



He sat down on the cold glass bench and one of the soldiers locked his hands in between his knees. Lucas didn’t notice he was busy staring at his father, now he could see the cuts and bruises over his face and arms, what have they done to you he thought a tear escaping his eye.



He sat there staring at his father for what seemed like an eternity, both of them locking eyes with each other and he could see the shame in his fathers’ eyes. What had he done to get himself thrown in here Lucas thought, and did they think he was some sort of accomplice to this action? He had never known his father to speak ill of the government, hell his father worked for them, had all his adult life. Lucas stared around the large round room, lavish in its carved cherry wood with scenes of animals running through fields and ancient soldiers standing tall and honorable decorated the upper balcony, the lower floor was lined with pews giving it more of a cathederal look then that of a court room.



At the front of the room stood three large wooden podiums the center one with the picture of blind justice and the scales. Ironic Lucas thought just was very much blind. Over the next hour people filled into the room and sat at the pews, which filled up fast as whatever was about to happen seemed close to getting started. Lucas couldn’t help but shake his leg from agitation, no one had spoken to him since yesterday and no one had even told him why he was here. He would have faith, he would simply tell them he was innocent of whatever this was, he had done nothing wrong he kept thinking to himself, as the last of the pews filled and then the camera’s activated and the rear door opened, three men in flowing black robes stepping up to the podiums.



They sat and spent a few moments talking amongst themselves. Then the man at the tallest pew turned to the cameras with a serious expression. “This is the trial of William and Lucas Christian vs New America for the charges of Treason, unpatriotic intent and collusion with a foreign government” he said for the benefit of the camera. Lucas sat bolt upright “NO, I am innocent he yelled” trying to stand but the chains had prevented it. No one even looked his way, no one even noticed when he spoke, not even the guard standing directly next to him, this must be sound proof he thought now panicked.



The trial took twenty minutes, twenty long minutes to seal Lucas’s fate, in that time they presented video documentation showing the times Lucas was absent, but the real evidence was video and emails as well as audio recording of his father handing over documents for money to someone unknown figure, Lucas knew at that point , his father was guilty and bevause his father was, the government assumed the son was as well. After all evidence was presented the center judge looked at his collegeges and then leaned forward to address Lucas’s father.



“William Christan, you are found guilty on all charges, the sentence will be death and under section twelve paragraph three until the new patriot and defense act will be carried out immediately” The just stated more for the camera’s then my father, and as Lucas watched in horror three drone cameras descended from the ceiling and surrounded his box as a yellow vapor began emenating from the floor. Lucas watched, screaming, begging for them to stop as the gas filled the chamber until he could only see his fathers’ hand as it beat against the glass, over and over, the very quickly slowing down and finally stopping. As Lucas watched the body of the man who was his world collapsed against the front of the glass to the cheer of the crowd gathered in the court room. He was stunned silent as tears freely ran down his face. Once it was done, the just turned to him and leveled a severe gaze at the young and now broken child. “Lucas Christian, for your part in this plot, you are hereby sentenced to ten years in federal prison, the sentence to begin immediately, all your family assets will be seized by order of the government” he finished and all three judges stood and bowed to the cheering crowd, as if they weren’t dispensers of law but actors in a play.  Lucas was quickly whisked from the courtroom and out of the building, still reeling from the death and betrayal he had just suffered at the hands of the two entities he relied on for protection and guidance, his father and his government.
